svg.title: Inspiration & References — Collage Study
svg.desc: Lightly aged 16:9 newspaper. The left quarter collages transparent chair and camera cutouts. The right three quarters analyze Return of the Obra Dinn and House Flipper through six official screenshots, numbered callouts and editable mechanism arrows. All type is English.
